findings.description: The whole `startFixRound` fixture was copied into all four shards rather than moved into `fix-round.mock.ts`. That covers the repo, origin and session `beforeEach`, the shell-script `gh` stub, `afterEach`, `reviewOnGitHub`, `seedPrMerge`, `gateWithPr`, `mergeOnGitHub`, `land`, `fix`, `payloads`, `prompt`, `routeAt` and `seedFinishedRound`. (Copies also at fix-round-answers.test.ts ~115-388, fix-round-kickoff.test.ts ~114-387, fix-round-refusals.test.ts ~118-391; `OPEN_THREAD`/`SURVIVOR_REFUSAL`/`expectRefusedUnwritten` and the file-level TMPDIR guard are likewise repeated. testing.md: "A mock used by more than one suite goes in `test/helpers/`".)

The files are named by topic, but tests were assigned without regard to topic. `fix-round-answers.test.ts` contains none of the round's answers tests, while `describe("the round's answers on GitHub")` stays in `fix-round.test.ts`. The kickoff describe sits in `fix-round-refusals.test.ts`, and the refusal tests are spread across three shards.

Helpers left from the copy were renamed with a leading `_` so lint stops flagging them, instead of being deleted. In `fix-round.test.ts`: `_seedPrMerge`, `_mergeOnGitHub`, `_land`, `_payloads`, `_prompt`, `_routeAt`, `_seedFinishedRound`. In the kickoff shard: `_ghFile`, `_mergeOnGitHub`, `_land`. The `landSession` import (both files) and the `kickoff` import (`fix-round.test.ts`) are used only by these dead helpers; deleting the helpers and those imports is the fix. (Also `_ghFile`, `_ghCalls`, `_routeAt`, `_seedFinishedRound` in fix-round-answers.test.ts and `_ghFile` in fix-round-refusals.test.ts.)

In `fix-round.test.ts` and `fix-round-kickoff.test.ts` (92-94), `endSandboxRun()` in `afterAll` does nothing: every gate child there runs inside `runMergeGate`, whose `finally` already ends the run, and neither shard calls `landSession`. Because it runs before `leftover()`, it would also quietly remove the `pup-gate-`/`pup-sandbox-` dirs of a run the code failed to end, hiding what the decision-100 guard exists to catch; only shards whose last child is `land()` need it.

The comment says the fix round's git/gh work is tested "in fix-round.test.ts". After the split, `startFixRound`'s tests live in `fix-round-kickoff.test.ts`, `fix-round-answers.test.ts` and `fix-round-refusals.test.ts`, and `fix-round.test.ts` keeps only the answers block and `ciReviewLookup`. The "Tests:" paragraphs in ADR 0090 (lines 345-354) also still point everything at `fix-round.test.ts`.

The helper sits in a new `src/test/helpers/` subfolder, while the existing shared mock `src/test/temp-dir.mock.ts` sits directly in `src/test/`; either move it beside its sibling or treat `helpers/` as the intended layout and say so.

`ThreadSeed` is now an exported interface in a `.mock.ts` imported by several shards, while naming.md says "Every exported type or interface is in a `*.types.ts` / `*.interface.ts` file" (arguable whether mocks are exempt).

`mockReturnValue('/opt/codegraph')` outlives its test, because the `beforeEach` only calls `vi.clearAllMocks()`, which clears calls but keeps implementations. The 9 tests that follow it in this shard run with a code graph present, against the file's "the code graph is a property of the test" rule (decision 51). The original file had the same leak; the split has narrowed it to this shard.
